correctness.rationale: Each zero-chip vacancy moves one step per simultaneous firing on its directed cycle; the exact global period is lcm(n_i)=d*product(u_i). With pairwise gcd d, generalized CRT says precisely simultaneous hole tuples whose phase-corrected labels have the same residue mod d occur. In each residue block the complement of a transversal is a join of r simplex boundaries, a sphere of dimension sum u_i-r-1. For disjoint forbidden-hyperedge systems the complement complex is (D_U*Delta(V)) union (Delta(U)*D_V), intersection D_U*D_V, so the cofibration homotopy pushout is a suspension. Iterating d blocks gives dimension N-(r-1)d-2, including d=1. The inspected independent code checks six CRT orbit families and direct GF2 homology of (3,4,5) (60 facets, 3255 faces, degree-8 beta=1); a separate direct subset enumeration independently confirmed these counts. Integer conclusion comes from the proved join/pushout, not from mod-two sampling.
